paragraphs.text: 1. I TRAVEL with the Rudras and the Vasus, with the Adityas and All-Gods I wander.
I hold aloft both Varuna and Mitra, Indra and Agni, and the Pair of Asvins.
2. I cherish and sustain high-swelling Soma, and Tvastar I support, Pusan, and Bhaga.
paragraphs.original: अहं सोममाहनसं बिभर्म्यहं त्वष्टारमुत पूषणं भगम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ somamāhanasaṃ bibharmyahaṃ tvaṣṭāramuta pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam |

paragraphs.text: I load with wealth the zealous sacrificer who pours the juice and offers his oblation
paragraphs.original: अहं दधामि द्रविणं हविष्मते सुप्राव्ये यजमानाय सुन्वते
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ dadhāmi draviṇaṃ haviṣmate suprāvye yajamānāya sunvate

paragraphs.text: 3. I am the Queen, the gatherer-up of treasures, most thoughtful, first of those who merit worship.
paragraphs.original: अहं राष्ट्री संगमनी वसूनां चिकितुषी प्रथमा यज्ञियानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ rāṣṭrī saṃgamanī vasūnāṃ cikituṣī prathamā yajñiyānām |

paragraphs.text: Thus Gods have stablished me in many places with many homes to enter and abide in.
paragraphs.original: तां मा देवा व्यदधुः पुरुत्रा भूरिस्थात्रां भूर्यावेशयन्तीम्
paragraphs.translit: tāṃ mā devā vyadadhuḥ purutrā bhūristhātrāṃ bhūryāveśayantīm

paragraphs.text: 4. Through me alone all eat the food that feeds them,-each man who sees, breathes, hears the word outspoken
paragraphs.original: मया सो अन्नमत्ति यो विपश्यति यः प्राणिति य ईं शृणोत्युक्तम् ।
paragraphs.translit: mayā so annamatti yo vipaśyati yaḥ prāṇiti ya īṃ śṛṇotyuktam |

paragraphs.text: They know it not, but yet they dwell beside me. Hear, one and all, the truth as I declare it.
paragraphs.original: अमन्तवो मां त उप क्षियन्ति श्रुधि श्रुत श्रद्धिवं ते वदामि
paragraphs.translit: amantavo māṃ ta upa kṣiyanti śrudhi śruta śraddhivaṃ te vadāmi

paragraphs.text: 5. I, verily, myself announce and utter the word that Gods and men alike shall welcome.
paragraphs.original: अहमेव स्वयमिदं वदामि जुष्टं देवेभिरुत मानुषेभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: ahameva svayamidaṃ vadāmi juṣṭaṃ devebhiruta mānuṣebhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: I make the man I love exceeding mighty, make him a sage, a Rsi, and a Brahman.
paragraphs.original: यं कामये तंतमुग्रं कृणोमि तं ब्रह्माणं तमृषिं तं सुमेधाम्
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ kāmaye taṃtamugraṃ kṛṇomi taṃ brahmāṇaṃ tamṛṣiṃ taṃ sumedhām

paragraphs.text: 6. I bend the bow for Rudra that his arrow may strike and slay the hater of devotion.
paragraphs.original: अहं रुद्राय धनुरा तनोमि ब्रह्मद्विषे शरवे हन्तवा उ ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ rudrāya dhanurā tanomi brahmadviṣe śarave hantavā u |

paragraphs.text: I rouse and order battle for the people, and I have penetrated Earth and Heaven.
paragraphs.original: अहं जनाय समदं कृणोम्यहं द्यावापृथिवी आ विवेश
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ janāya samadaṃ kṛṇomyahaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa

paragraphs.text: 7. On the world's summit I bring forth the Father: my home is in the waters, in the ocean.
paragraphs.original: अहं सुवे पितरमस्य मूर्धन्मम योनिरप्स्वन्तः समुद्रे ।
paragraphs.translit: ahaṃ suve pitaramasya mūrdhanmama yonirapsvantaḥ samudre |

paragraphs.text: Thence I extend o'er all existing creatures, and touch even yonder heaven with my forehead.
paragraphs.original: ततो वि तिष्ठे भुवनानु विश्वोतामूं द्यां वर्ष्मणोप स्पृशामि
paragraphs.translit: tato vi tiṣṭhe bhuvanānu viśvotāmūṃ dyāṃ varṣmaṇopa spṛśāmi

paragraphs.text: 8. I breathe a strong breath like the wind and tempest, the while I hold together all existence.
paragraphs.original: अहमेव वात इव प्र वाम्यारभमाणा भुवनानि विश्वा ।
paragraphs.translit: ahameva vāta iva pra vāmyārabhamāṇā bhuvanāni viśvā |

paragraphs.text: Beyond this wide earth and beyond the heavens I have become so mighty in my grandeur.
paragraphs.original: परो दिवा पर एना पृथिव्यैतावती महिना सं बभूव
paragraphs.translit: paro divā para enā pṛthivyaitāvatī mahinā saṃ babhūva
